intro: Vaelen bled his levies on your oak doors. I came with ledgers, not battering rams, to collect every sack of grain Thornwick owes.
phase_lines: Every bolt your archers loose was forged from stolen ore—let us audit the interest.
So the border dogs still have teeth. Bring forward the cinder-censer!
You call this victory? You only bought these people a slower death in Redmarsh.
death_line: Look south... past the smoke... Redmarsh is already dry... you saved them for the buzzards...

taunt_class.warrior: Another rusty shield-post standing in the mud for a crown that forgot his name.
taunt_class.archer: Hide behind your hedges, poacher—salt-tax writs reach sixty paces easily.
taunt_class.mage: A disgraced clerk playing with chalk while my seals drain the entire valley.
taunt_class.necromancer: You count paupers' ribs, little sexton; I foreclose on entire provinces.

intro: Two causeways, two thousand corpses, and still you climb toward my cisterns with dry canteens. Pry the mountain keys from my gauntlets.
phase_lines: The stone of Ironheart has broken finer armies than yours on those narrow bridges.
You breached the outer redoubts—good. Now bleed where the air is thin.
Fools! Below this bastion lies a dry sea—you are tearing down the only dam left!
death_line: The lower valves... rusted shut years ago... fear kept the raiders off the coast road...

taunt_class.warrior: Test your border iron against mountain basalt, soldier—see which cracks first.
taunt_class.archer: Your goose-feathers bounce off slag-plate like hailstones on a slate roof.
taunt_class.mage: Sparks and whispers won't cool my boilers, scholar—step closer to the steam.
taunt_class.necromancer: Plenty of dry bones in my ditch, clerk, and not a drop of water to wash them.

intro: Admiral Kael bought you time with his life, land-rat, yet you still board a sinking hull. Let the tide judge between us before the powder blows.
phase_lines: Mind the slick planks—blood and whale oil turn a good swordsman into ballast.
Stubborn bastards! Heave the pitch-pots topside and light the forecastle!
Sailing into the volcanic straits isn't victory—you are rowing straight into a furnace!
death_line: Look east... ash clouds already touch the horizon... I tried to sink the ferryman...

taunt_class.warrior: Heavy plate makes fine anchor-weight once my marines sweep you into the scuppers.
taunt_class.archer: Hard to line up a clean shot when the quarterdeck rolls beneath your boots.
taunt_class.mage: Salt spray dampens your sleeves, mage—one spark here and we both swim in fire.
taunt_class.necromancer: The deep sea keeps no probate rolls, witness—only crabs and salt.

intro: Four provinces burned to bring you to my steps, and now you smash the chains holding the cinders down. Prove your flesh can hold a sun.
phase_lines: Two conduit pillars lie in ruin, yet enough ember remains in my plate to unmake you.
You drink the unbound flame like wine—tell me, does it taste like ashes yet?
Look at your hands! Even if you strike me down, you can never leave this throne!
death_line: Sit, then... feel how heavy the quiet becomes when nothing left dares to burn...

taunt_class.warrior: You carried a shield across four provinces only to melt inside it on my dais.
taunt_class.archer: Your wooden shafts turn to cinders ten paces before they ever reach my gorget.
taunt_class.mage: You measured pressure valves in books, scholar; now stand inside the furnace.
taunt_class.necromancer: No ledger can audit primordial fire, clerk—even the dead turn to ash here.

name: Warden Krell
intro: Every cart crossing Alder Ford pays my iron tithe. You carry steel instead of silver—let us see how much blood your ribs can spare for the toll-box.
phase_lines: Raise the floodgates! Let the cold current drag their ankles down!
My hounds have tasted better mail than yours—tear their hamstrings!
Hold the causeway, boys! None cross this river while Krell still breathes!
defeat: The river... takes the toll anyway... you'll drown in the mud further south...

name: Lady Selene of the Mill
intro: The Crown starved my tenants to feed its border garrisons. Now my millstones grind bone instead of barley, and you have wandered straight into the hopper.
phase_lines: Turn the waterwheel faster! Let the chaff choke their lungs!
You dare strike a noblewoman with muddy boots? Flay them alive!
If my house falls today, these stones will crush us all together!
defeat: Listen to the wheel... slowing down... at last... no more hunger...

name: Old Briarmaw
intro: *A deafening roar shakes loose dead leaves and moss as the ancient, iron-barked beast drags its scarred bulk from the riverbed, yellow eyes fixed on your throat.*
phase_lines: *Splintering timber cracks as thick brambles erupt from the muddy earth.*
*A resonant, earth-shaking bellow sends flocks of crows scattering skyward.*
*Sap-streaked jaws snap shut with the force of a falling portcullis.*
defeat: *With a final groaning crash like a felled oak, the great beast sinks motionless into the silt.*

name: Malakor the Drowned
intro: They weighted my ankles with chains and cast me into the black peat. Yet the bog refused to digest my hatred—and now I drag every living fool down into the cold.
phase_lines: Rise, forgotten dead! Pull them beneath the black water!
Feel the marsh-chill creeping into your marrow—you cannot swing what you cannot feel!
Your breath turns to mist! The fen claims another trophy!
defeat: The water... grows warm... finally... let the silt cover my eyes...

name: Matriarch Voss
intro: You trample my sacred leech-beds and burn my incense reeds. Come closer, little trespasser—my venom-pots have been simmering since the last full moon.
phase_lines: Breathe deep the green vapor! Watch your veins turn black!
My children, swarm their ankles! Leave nothing for the buzzards!
Even in death, my blood will poison every well in this wretched marsh!
defeat: My brews... spilled in the mud... the bog will drink my curse...

name: The Peat Monolith
intro: *Hundreds of bog-preserved skeletons fuse together with rotting timber and black mud, rising like a towering idol of drowned centuries.*
phase_lines: *Dozens of jawbones clatter in unison as noxious marsh-gas vents from its ribs.*
*Heavy mud-caked limbs slam down, sending waves of foul brine across the reeds.*
*Glowing wisp-lights flare inside hollow eye sockets as shattered bones knit back together.*
defeat: *The binding sinews snap, collapsing into a silent mound of wet peat and bleached skulls.*

name: Captain Draven
intro: I have weathered forty gales and hanged three mutinous crews from my yardarm. You think a handful of land-rats will take my cove? Boarders, clear the rocks!
phase_lines: Swivel guns, fire! Turn that driftwood into splinters!
Hook their shields and drag them into the surf!
No quarter! Strip their corpses before the tide comes in!
defeat: A fair broadside... bury me below the tideline... where the Crown can't reach...

name: Oracle Nerissa
intro: The salt-currents whispered your names before your boots ever touched our shingle. The abyss hungers for warm blood, and I am merely its faithful cupbearer.
phase_lines: Let the crushing pressure of the deep break your brittle bones!
Salt burns the eyes, brine fills the throat—kneel before the endless tide!
The leviathan stirs beneath the reef! Your struggle is mere foam!
defeat: The waves... fall silent... what lies beneath... has abandoned me...

name: The Rust-Hulk
intro: *Barnacle-encrusted hull plates and fractured ship anchors groan as a colossal crab-like horror heaves itself out of the crashing surf.*
phase_lines: *Massive rusted pincers slam shut like shipwright shears, sparking against stone.*
*Pressurized jets of scalding brine erupt from vents along its iron carapace.*
*The ground trembles as the beast rears back, crushing basalt boulders beneath its weight.*
defeat: *With a shriek of tearing iron and shattering shell, the leviathan topples sideways into the tide.*

name: Grand Inquisitor Varro
intro: Every treason leaves an ink-stain on the realm's ledger. By decree of the Cinder Throne, your names are struck from the living and consigned to purifying flame.
phase_lines: Seize them! Let the iron brands teach them proper reverence!
Your heresy ends at the edge of my halberd!
Burn the parchment, burn the flesh—only ash remains pure!
defeat: My ledger... stained with my own blood... the Crown... cannot fall...

name: Pyre-Marshal Kael
intro: I forged my armor in the ashes of three rebel cities. Step onto the scorched stone, mercenary—let us see if your steel holds its temper in my furnace.
phase_lines: Fan the coals! Turn this courtyard into a crucible!
You fight well for dead men, yet fire consumes all!
Even if my plate melts to my skin, I will drag you into the embers!
defeat: The forge... grows cold... at last... the smoke clears...

name: The Ashen Sovereign
intro: You marched through mud, brine, and soot to reach an empty throne. Look upon the embers of our glorious realm—and burn beside its last true king.
phase_lines: Kneel before the cinders of your own ambition!
Let crown-fire scour every trace of your defiance from this world!
If I cannot rule these ashes, nothing living shall inherit them!
defeat: Only cold dust... remains... tell me... was the crown worth the smoke...

intro: *Twin granite fists slam into the highland cairn as the dying continent's tectonic agony shakes loose a storm of ancient stone.*
phase_lines: *Living basalt groans beneath primeval runes, splitting the ridge with jagged fissures.*
*Twin granite wardens lock shields beside the colossus as boulders cascade down the pass.*
*Its chest-core flares with blinding earth-fire—one final fracture away from eternal stillness.*
death_line: *With a long, resonant sigh of settling shale, the Elder Juggernaut returns to silent mountain stone.*

taunt_class.warrior: *Your steel sword rings against primeval granite like a twig against a cliffside.*
taunt_class.archer: *Arrow shafts splinter into dust against the living bedrock of the cairn.*
taunt_class.mage: *Earth-breaking sorcery stirs a deep, sorrowful rumble inside the ancient core.*
taunt_class.necromancer: *No bone or soul binds this titan—only the wounded stone of Thornvael itself.*

intro: Cowards! Running across the sea like rats off a burning hull! If Thornvael must drown in fire, then no one leaves this pier alive!
phase_lines: Drag them into the pitch! Anchor their bones!
Torch the eastern war pier! No mercy for the rearguard!
Every sail out there is a betrayal of the dead! Stay and burn with the continent!
death_line: The sails... past the horizon... you let them... escape a dying world...

taunt_class.warrior: Heavy plate just helps you sink faster once my anchor chains hook your gorget.
taunt_class.archer: Try drawing a bowstring when the war pier splits beneath your boots.
taunt_class.mage: Sparks don't quench harbor pitch, scholar—step closer to the edge.
taunt_class.necromancer: The black surf swallows flesh and bone alike—no corpses left to raise here.

intro: You bled through three provinces to chase a shadow up Ashveil Gorge! One step onto that summit shrine and every secret of the Iron Pact vanishes!
phase_lines: Snipers on the switchbacks—bleed their vanguard dry!
The border ciphers were only the first ledger—you are too late to stop the Caldera!
Keep back from the teleport flagstones! I will not die on this freezing pass!
death_line: My satchel... the Royal Cipher-Keys... no, you cannot unravel what the Pact has lit...

taunt_class.warrior: All that meteoric ironplate won't catch a man who walks through ley-doors.
taunt_class.archer: Shoot faster, ranger—my teleport circle is already humming.
taunt_class.mage: You read wardstone primers while I rewrote the Crown Vault's ciphers.
taunt_class.necromancer: You haggle with single corpses; I sold an entire kingdom's coffers.

intro: Three centuries of unbroken vigil turned my flesh to granite so law might outlive mortal folly. Sunder my anchors if you dare—and answer for the chaos you unchain.
phase_lines: While the West and East Resonance Anchors sing, no mortal blade can scratch eternal stone.
Both anchors shattered—draw close, then, and taste the twin blades of Petrified Judgment!
Without law, without stone, humanity will bleed again before the century turns!
death_line: The empire was peace... without law... without stone... you are only... dust in the wind...

taunt_class.warrior: Your shield arm grows heavy with granite stasis—soon you too will stand forever.
taunt_class.archer: Bolts shatter against white marble tempered by three hundred winters.
taunt_class.mage: Your fragile sparks only warm the frost of the Crown Vault for a heartbeat.
taunt_class.necromancer: Even death submits to stillness inside these walls, sexton.

intro: Look through the eye of a smelter's kiln, mortal! Your cities are slag and your blood is fuel for the Great Cleansing—break my obsidian pylons if your bones can survive the fire!
phase_lines: Two obsidian conduit pillars feed my throne—cinder-imps, bury them in ash!
Both conduits broken?! Then let the cavern roof rain meteors and liquid rock!
I see your ambition beneath the soot! Reach for the Crown of Thorns and Cinder and see if it melts your hand!
death_line: Burn, then... conqueror... take the fire... and see if the crown does not melt your bones as it melted mine...

taunt_class.warrior: Meteoric plate turns white-hot inside my Furnace Heart—melt inside your shell!
taunt_class.archer: Wooden shafts ignite before they cross half the magma chasm.
taunt_class.mage: You brought books to a volcano, scholar—watch your wards evaporate.
taunt_class.necromancer: No bones survive the kiln, clerk—only cinders and sovereign iron.
